description: Atlas Esgotos: Despoluição de Bacias Hidrográficas is a 2017 study by Brazil's national water and sanitation agency ANA with the national environmental sanitation secretariat, giving a diagnosis of sewage collection and treatment in Brazil, its effect on receiving water bodies, the treatment investments needed and an integrated strategy. In 2020 ANA published a revised survey of municipal sewage treatment plants and updated municipal sewage indices; the current records cover 3,668 plants in 2,007 municipalities. The metadata record offers plant layers and spreadsheets for 2013 and 2019, a table by municipality, layers of load removal, dilution capacity, treatment solution by BOD removal and phosphorus and nitrogen analyses, a data dictionary, executive summaries in three languages and a web map. Coverage is Brazil at 1:1,000,000. Access is free as shapefiles, spreadsheets and PDFs, and reuse is allowed with the source cited. Caveats: the plant survey dates from 2019 to 2020, and the metadata were last changed in April 2024. Simulation uses: locating treatment plants and their capacity for wastewater network and receiving-water models. Related records: SNIS (data-brazil-snis-sanitation-information-system) and HidroWeb (data-brazil-ana-hidroweb-hydrometeorological-network).
